operations.comment: ; The Blue Marlin (USA) - commented ca65 source (ROMAtlas commentary round 5, checkpoint pass-005).
; Original bytes are local-only; this file rebuilds the ROM byte-for-byte with layout.cfg.
; Built from commentary/before/game.asm + commentary/notes/annotations.txt by
; analysis/tools/commentary_build.py; either may be edited, but keep them in sync.
; Memory model used throughout (established in round-1 disassembly, analysis/investigation.md):
; MMC3 PRG mode 0. CPU $C000-$DFFF = bank 14 and $E000-$FFFF = bank 15 are fixed.
; R6 selects the $8000 bank (shadow BankShadow8000), R7 the $A000 bank (shadow
; BankShadowA000). Gameplay logic lives in banks 0/1 (mapped together), the sound
; driver in banks 2/3, graphics/layout helpers in banks 4-7, sea map data in banks
; 8-11 and fight/result scripts in banks 12/13. ROM operands into $8000-$BFFF that
; are issued from the fixed banks depend on the runtime mapping and stay numeric
; unless the calling contract is known.
; Object table: 16 slots indexed by X, stored as parallel arrays at $0380-$03FF
; (see Obj* symbols). Coordinates are 16-bit world positions (hi/lo split arrays).
; PPU update queue: $0300.. holds a command stream built by the game and executed
; by the NMI-time interpreter PpuQueue_Execute (command bytes $00-$09, see there).
; ---- Hardware registers (CPU address space) ----
; MMC3 registers (writes to ROM space). PRG mode 0 is used: $C000=bank 14 and
; $E000=bank 15 are fixed, R6 selects the $8000 bank and R7 the $A000 bank.
; bank-select register index: 2 KiB CHR
; bank-select register index: 2 KiB CHR

; bank-select register index: PRG $8000
; bank-select register index: PRG $A000

; joypad bit layout after the read loop (A B Sel St U D L R)
; PPU queue: end of stream
; PPU queue: set VRAM address (2 bytes, little endian in queue)
; ObjState bit 7: slot in use and drawn
; number of object slots
